alt: The Apple iMac G4 from 2002, with its iconic white half-dome base and flat-panel display floating on a polished metal arm — the same design Apple reportedly revived for its 2026 HomePad smart home hub
story: Apple announced its long-awaited smart home hub for October 13, 2026, and the big design reveal is that it's a miniature version of the iMac G4 from 2002 — the same half-dome base, polished metal arm, and floating display that Apple used for a computer they stopped selling in 2004.
why_funny: After years of promising to reinvent the smart home, Apple's breakthrough was to dig up a design they buried during the George W. Bush administration.
